name: HMI integration
description: Test your HMI in real time using the VR integration. Quickly evaluate interaction flows, visibility, and usability without waiting for physical prototypes.

name: HMD Compatibility
description: Optimized for Varjo XR-3 and compatible with HTC Vive, Oculus and others. This ensures high-fidelity visualisation across different headsets and studio setups.

name: CE Certification
description: Fully compliant with Directive 2006/42/EC, featuring industrial-grade safety interlocks for corporate studio deployment. This guarantees it meets the safety standards required for daily professional use.

name: Customizable
description: Easy to add physical properties to customize it how you want. Adapt hardware inputs, dimensions, and materials so the setup mirrors your unique design environment.

name: Mobile
description: Designed to be easily moved, for example to a presentation room or next to a full-scale mockup. This mobility allows teams to seamlessly integrate DigiPHY into different stages of the design workflow.

name: IPAD
description: Save and switch instantly between layouts. Quickly compare design variations or present alternative setups directly from the tablet interface.
